spam.instructions: Does this chat message constitute unsolicited promotional spam for the Aosus community?

criteria.true: Unsolicited commercial promotion: investment/IPO solicitation, guaranteed returns, crypto schemes, fake or vague job offers, work-from-home earning claims, referral/rewards schemes, money-making apps, or any advertisement the recipient did not ask for. Obfuscated spam (extra symbols, mixed scripts, QR/link lures) still counts.
criteria.false: Legitimate discussion, including talking ABOUT investments or jobs, criticizing or quoting spam to warn others, technical talk with English terms/code/URLs, or messages with no promotional intent.

language_violation.instructions: Is this message primarily written in a language other than Arabic?

criteria.true: The message body is mostly non-Arabic prose (e.g. a full English/Chinese advertisement or conversation).
criteria.false: Arabic discussion that happens to contain English technical terms, code, URLs, product names, error messages, or short quoted foreign material.

spam_category.instructions: What is the primary category of this message?

criteria.investment: Investment or financial solicitation: IPOs, trading, guaranteed returns, crypto.
criteria.jobs: Employment or income opportunity: job ads, hiring, work-from-home offers.
criteria.referral: Referral or rewards scheme: invite links, bonuses, money-making apps.
criteria.other_ads: Other unsolicited advertisement not covered above.
criteria.legitimate: Not promotional spam: normal discussion, questions, criticism of spam.
